description: Source code for INA219 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing I2C communication, sensor data fetching, configuration, and power management.

methods.name: ina219_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the INA219 device via I2C.

methods.name: ina219_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the INA219 device via I2C.

methods.name: ina219_reg_field_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register on the INA219 device.

methods.name: ina219_set_msr_delay
methods.description: Sets measurement delay based on configuration.

methods.name: ina219_set_config
methods.description: Configures INA219 device with specified settings.

methods.name: ina219_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (voltage, current, power) from INA219.

methods.name: ina219_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to physical values.

methods.name: ina219_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for INA219.
